results.title: England vs Iran Betting Tips & Match Predictions
highlights:
The premier match of Group B will be played between England and Iran. Arguably the matchup between the strongest and the weakest nation of the group, at least on paper. However, Team Melli has proven as a tough team to get by.
[...]
Will England struggle in their opening match, you can find that out with the help of our England vs Iran prediction.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Form and Team News
[...]
England had a terrible display in the Nations League in the lead-up to the tournament. They finished fourth in their group, causing them to drop down from League A to League B the next year.
[...]
The Three Lions haven’t won a single match in six games. They drew three and lost three. In fact, they only scored four goals in total, with only two of them being from open play. If England are to start their campaign with a win, they need to take Iran seriously.
[...]
On the other hand, Iran went through a coaching change just before the start of the tournament. Dragan Skocic, the man who led them to the championship will now be replaced by Carlos Queiroz. Coaching change this deep prior to the start of a major competition is never a good thing.
[...]
If Iran is to rally under Queiroz and start performing, they need to do it fast. Also, it appears that star attacker, Sardar Azmoun, should be fit enough to start this match despite his injury woes this season.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Starting Lineups
[...]
Here is what we should expect in terms of the starting eleven for both teams.
[...]
- Iran: GK: Danny Ward; DEF: Sadegh Moharrami, Hossein Kanani, Majid Hosseini, Ehsan Hajsafi; MID: Ahmad Noorollahi, Saeid Ezatolahi, Milad Sarlak; ATC: Sardar Azmoun, Mehdi Taremi, Alireza Jahanbakhsh.
[...]
- England: GK: Jordan Pickford; DEF: Kieran Trippier, John Stones, Eric Dier, Harry Maguire, Luke Shaw; MID: Declan Rice, Jude Bellingham; ATC: Phil Foden, Mason Mount, Harry Kane.
[...]
## England vs Iran – Betting Tips
[...]
Even with all the struggles, Gareth Southgate has had entering this tournament, we think that the match against Iran is the best way for them to start their campaign. England have an easy opponent and are heavily favoured at odds of 1.36.
[...]
That said, we don’t expect too many goals. The best that Iran can do is make England a bit uncomfortable at the start of the game. Therefore our England vs Iran prediction also points to the Under 2.25 goals market at 1.86.
[...]
It is very much probable that England will bag this one by 2:0, given at odds of 5.50.

results.title: England World Cup 2026 team preview: Players to watch, group and squad list | World Cup 2026 News | Al Jazeera
highlights:
It has now been 60 years of hurt for England, who lifted their only World Cup title in 1966. But while the Three Lions are certainly genuine contenders this time around, they come into the 2026 edition in a rather unsettled mood.
[...]
However, it’s fair to say that it was not the toughest group, and their performances in recent friendlies have drawn boos from fairly unenthused Wembley crowds, not least the defeats to Senegal and Japan.
[...]
Can England get a tune out of the likes of Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane? Can the Three Lions find a way back to playing entertaining football? And does coach Thomas Tuchel actually know his best team?
[...]
In addition to contending with this record, the former Chelsea and PSG boss Tuchel has also faced criticism over the failure to improve England’s style of play, which is still often marred by slow, sideways passes.
[...]
And while it’s logical to experiment, it’s also not clear he really knows his best team, and attempts to play a false nine or two number 10s have not come off.
[...]
Nevertheless, there’s no doubt that Tuchel is an elite manager and his solid, well-organised England side won their group with a 100 percent record (eight wins from eight), including tough wins away at Serbia and Albania, and conceded zero goals in the process.
[...]
Despite winning the golden boot at the 2018 World Cup, England have often failed to get the best out of their captain and record goalscorer at major tournaments.
[...]
However, if England can field a relatively fresh Kane in North America, the 33-year-old should be high on confidence following his best-ever season in front of goal.
[...]
England’s captain also has his country’s World Cup scoring record in sight as he needs just two more strikes to equal Gary Lineker’s record of 10 goals in the tournament.
[...]
Bellingham is perhaps the most effective out of several talented England number 10s, but the 22-year-old has had a frustrating club season as he has contended with injuries and his side’s frequently poor form, and accordingly, his England appearances have also been sporadic recently.
[...]
Aston Villa’s Morgan Rogers may have staked a strong claim to start ahead of him based on appearances under Tuchel and his sparkling club form.
[...]
Group L contains some tricky opponents, and England face a particularly tough opener against 11th-ranked Croatia, who beat England in the 2018 semifinal.
